items.caption:
Some birds sleep while flying.
Great frigatebirds wearing small brain-wave (EEG) recorders slept only about 41 minutes a day in flight (0.69 h), mostly while soaring, and often with one brain half at a time; back on land they sleep at least 9 hours a day (Nature Communications, 2016). One species, a small study.
